signals.title: Default use_vision to 'auto' instead of always-on
signals.description: Every step shipped a full screenshot regardless of whether the step needed visual grounding. 'auto' mode was already implemented but not the default.

signals.title: Tighten compaction trigger so it engages on typical-length tasks
signals.description: MessageCompactionSettings was enabled by default but its trigger (25 steps / ~10k tokens) was tuned for very long runs, so most 10-30 step tasks never compacted history at all.
